messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Annex III, 2.4.5.2

2.4.5.2. Distribution, deposition and drift of plant protection products The machinery or related product shall be designed and constructed to ensure that the plant protection product is deposited on target areas, to minimise losses to other areas and to prevent drift of plant protection products to the environment. Where appropriate, an even distribution and homogeneous deposition shall be ensured.

response.text:
The machinery or related product | shallBeDesignedToEnsure | deposition of the plant protection product on target areas | | shall be designed and constructed to ensure that the plant protection product is deposited on target areas
The machinery or related product | shallBeDesignedToMinimise | losses of the plant protection product to other areas | | to minimise losses to other areas
The machinery or related product | shallBeDesignedToPrevent | drift of plant protection products to the environment | | to prevent drift of plant protection products to the environment
The machinery or related product | shallEnsure | even distribution and homogeneous deposition | where appropriate | Where appropriate, an even distribution and homogeneous deposition shall be ensured
